reason: Riset mendokumentasikan pekerjaan ritual, alat musik dengan elang, serta penanaman serat, tetapi tidak mendokumentasikan tubuh/ikonografi atau manifestasi aktif dewa. Penggambaran manusia biasa dalam adegan kerajinan gagal Uji Sangar; membesarkan tubuh atau memberi kuasa cahaya/elang sebagai tubuh dewa akan mengarang. Ditunda sesuai §6.5 tanpa panggilan gambar.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No image generated; do not invent bodily form or manifestation.
